faqSection.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqSection.subtitle: Common answers regarding E-Stamping, property registry, tax filing, and visiting Chamber 121.

items.question: How can I verify the authenticity of an E-Stamp paper?
items.answer: Every e-stamp paper generated has a unique 16-digit e-stamp code and a QR code. You can verify it instantly on the official Punjab E-Stamping portal (es.punjab.gov.pk) or through our office scanner.

items.question: What documents are required to file an annual income tax return?
items.answer: You need your CNIC, salary certificates or business bank statements for the tax year (July 1 to June 30), utility bills, property/vehicle purchase receipts, and wealth reconciliation details.

items.question: How long does property registration take at District Court Sahiwal?
items.answer: Once Fard Malkiat is retrieved and e-stamp duty is deposited, deed drafting and witness execution before the Sub-Registrar can typically be completed on the same day.

items.question: Can I send documents on WhatsApp before visiting?
items.answer: Yes! You can WhatsApp your documents to 0305-7902744. Our team will review them, calculate the required stamp duty or taxes, and prepare drafts in advance.
